plan.question: Does the frozen contrast-only width8 forward surrogate respond correctly to a small unseen depth translation?
plan.only_main_factor: Translate the nominal discrete support along physical y by -2,0,+2 grid rows; contrast remains .5.
plan.fixed: Frozen width8 checkpoint, IEEE policy, source0, 24 receivers, 2000 times, original float32 discrete physics, normalization, time reconstruction and homogeneous background; no optimization, training or calibration.
plan.support_checks: 449 cells for each mask; translate with zero fill without roll/wrap; every cell inside the physical domain; save masks and actual shift in meters from y_m spacing.
plan.data_role: Prospective frozen diagnostic validation; immediately becomes development data after review. Never an independent final test.
baselines: Zero scattered field/trace plus homogeneous background
Nominal zero-shift replay as implementation control
plan.observations: Generate three float32 physical field-snapshot/receiver labels after saving protocol and hashes. No shifted label may become a reference prediction.
metrics: full and scattered field relative L2 separately
full and scattered receiver relative L2 separately
finite symmetric geometry response P(+2)-P(-2) versus F(+2)-F(-2): relative L2 and cosine
network/lookup per-case error ratios, source and receiver coordinate checks
plan.screening: Predeclare shifted scatter field and receiver error <=.20 for both signs, finite geometry-response receiver relative error <=.20 and cosine >=.90. These are engineering screening rules, not a claim of physical derivative or inversion accuracy. No threshold tuning from new labels.
plan.success: Both signs meet screens, finite response meets screen, and network beats nominal lookup scatter receiver error on both shifted states; supports only this discrete local depth transfer.
plan.failure: A valid run fails any screen: record the failing metric and sign; next examine geometry-family coverage with the same architecture, not automatic network growth.
plan.inconclusive: Mask/control/hash checks fail, nonfinite outputs, or finite physical response norm is <=1e-6 times nominal scattered trace norm; stop interpretation and audit implementation/response scale.
plan.next_if_success: Preregister a depth-family derivative/data protocol before any unknown-geometry material inversion. A three-state finite response is not a local Jacobian.
plan.budget: Exactly3 physical and3 network predictions; estimated <2min, cap5min, no training/download. If nominal replay requires repair or resource cap is exceeded, stop and preserve artifacts.
plan.boundary: Geometry is supplied as forward input. No blind localization, unknown-shape recovery, noise robustness or full-inversion cost claim.

execution: IEEE float32 physical and neural forwards; metric accumulation float64; no fitting; four CPU threads
verification_budget: Separate replay may repeat3 physical and3 network predictions for bit parity, no method changes
